_note: ALL STAND-IN (F7). Smudge is the only voice here. {you} and {them} are hero first names, {n} a number, {call} the stat.
level_text: Holds cards back for the right call and lets a lost round go.
start: Cards on the table. Speed goes first, then whatever is called.
Three turns a round, three rounds to win. Smudge has the ink ready.
Pick up to three. Press Ready. Try not to look smug.
round_start: Round {n}: {calls}. Plan for the last one now.
you_round: Smudge stamps it in your colour.
them_round: That round goes the other way.
big: {n} from {you}. Smudge wrote it down twice.
sapped: Something took a bite out of {you}.
win: Duel won. Smudge closes the book on it.
lose: Lost. Smudge has already shuffled for the next.
paid: +{n} gold. Practice pays for the first {max} wins a day.
unpaid: Practice pays for the first {max} wins a day. That was for the joy of it.
cant_three: Three cards a turn at most.
stand_down: You stood down. The round is theirs, the energy is yours.
